sources: .transcribe/brand/round-2/refs (re-encoded copies; only files with no original, e.g. crops/)
method.dedup: sha256 of file bytes; refs copies of an analysed original are skipped by name
method.resize: 200 px wide, Lanczos, aspect kept; GIF first frame
method.clustering: k-means k=8 in CIELAB (D65), k-means++ init, seed 0; cluster centre converted back to sRGB hex
method.oklch: L 0-1, C chroma, h degrees (null when C<0.002)
method.top_chromatic: the 3 clusters with highest OKLCH C among clusters with share >= 0.02
method.gradient: centre vertical, centre horizontal and both corner diagonals; each line median-filtered (window 9 px, per CIELAB channel); keep the line with largest OKLCH chroma range; 5 evenly spaced stops
method.directions: from .transcribe/brand/round-2/step-1-report.md section 3; Color shelf is not one of the four and is flagged separately
